Disable Mechanism

Training Time (TT): 12 weeks

The ability to foil locks, traps, vehicles, electronic systems, and other simple or complex mechanisms, typically with the use of some type of tools.

 

Characters may spend more than one round attempting to open a particular lock or otherwise disable a device; for each additional minute (specified in advance), add a +1 modifier (up to a maximum of +10). On the subject of lock-picking (likely the most common use of this skill), characters can attempt to open a lock that they have previously failed to open, with a -5 modifier for each previous failed attempt.

 

This skill may also be used to design and install lock mechanisms, traps, secret doors or passage ways, etc., although the Handicraft (artificer) skill is required to construct such mechanisms.
